notes: The whole image is 1666 by 2146 pixels. Both supplied halves are 1666 by 1153; a begins at whole y=0 and b at whole y=993. All reported boxes use the whole-image coordinate system.

This is a typescript with handwritten mathematical fills, cancellations, leaders, two squares and a slanted marginal note. No title or date appears. The lower-left 18 is archival numbering; no authorial manuscript page number is asserted.

The page continues de Kostant and records maps from Dyn_c to ST_c and Un_c, then a map from Un_c to an underlined slashed-oval object. The main square places Dyn_c above Un_c and ST_c above the slashed-oval object. The small square has L and P on the left and overwritten Z_o and a z-like(e) form on the right.

The rational-point discussion gives a Levi/cocharacter argument and invokes a dense open subset of the handwritten g-like(2). The handwritten replacement qualifies quasi-deployment with si Z_o=e and reads que G est, not the grammatical repair soit.

The NB explicitly requires checking that c′ comes from a Dynkin class c invariant par Γ, and says il n’est pas clair que cette propriété, with de c inserted, follows from invariance of c′; it adds faute de savoir si c↦c′ est injectif sur les classes de Dynkin. These hesitations remain literal.

The margin reads Il n’est en effet pas le cas, p.ex. pour A_2,A_4 (cela l’est pour A_3). I do not settle editorially which preceding assertion its opening refers to, nor do I verify these type-specific claims.

The semi-local remark retains the provisional restriction de car. nulle jusqu’à nouvel ordre. The following paragraph asks for exact Dynkin–Kostant parabolic classes and whether their stabilizer in Autext(G_o) equals that of the corresponding Dynkin classes, et pas str. plus grand.

The last paragraph begins an observation about a filtration of the forgetful functor defined by a unipotent element; the conjugacy-class sentence is incomplete on this sheet. The literal source ending is der-. Following the supplied joining convention and C, reading.tex leaves der open with a TeX comment rather than supplying the next-page continuation.
The grammatical phrase de cette classe rationnel is retained without concordance correction. Its wording is directly visible in half b.

The visible uncertainty at invariante concerns the high trace and possible overlap, not a reason to modernize spelling. Likewise the slanted line within paraboliques is preserved as ink without deciding whether it is a lexical hyphen.
No chronology was assigned to the small-square central overprint. The two standalone cancelling x cells have graphic representations and separate inventory rows; no hidden letters were invented.

C/H macro differences alone, such as operatorname versus mathrm, add versus inserted where no physical relation is lost, and emph versus source underlining, are excluded from the difference list. Confidence and doubt-state changes are explicitly listed as reading loci rather than automatically treated as demonstrated errors.
